summary: Iteration 81 — Bulk Email (Broadcasts) backend fully verified end-to-end (15/15 pytest passes + real send confirmed via supervisor logs 'sent=1, failed=0'). Frontend code reviewed and looks correct (proper data-testids, env-driven API URL, 3-step composer wizard, unsubscribe flow). Full Playwright UI walkthrough blocked by the Emergent preview iframe wake-up wrapper which intercepts top-level DOM interactions on the preview URL, and the .static. fallback URL gets 404 on the auth API. Recommend the main agent self-verifies UI by clicking through the flow.

minor.issue: If audience is empty the campaign goes to status='failed' (correct) but no failure-reason is returned to the caller — endpoint returns 200 {status:'sending'} regardless. Consider returning audience size or surfacing failure asynchronously in toast.
When RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set, the endpoint accepts ANY payload — fine for now, but flag to set the secret in production. Also no signature/HMAC verification, only a plain shared secret.

action_items: Main agent: manually click through /admin/broadcasts in your dev env (Emergent preview iframe blocked Playwright). Verify: composer opens → audience preview shows count > 0 (a TEST_iter81 seeded paid row exists during the test fixture only) → template fills subject/body → send-now triggers toast.
Optional: surface 'audience empty' error in toast when send-now is called against an empty audience (currently status stays 'failed' silently on the campaign doc).
Optional: add HMAC signature verification on /api/webhooks/resend (Resend supports svix signing) before production rollout.
Public unsubscribe URL in emails uses BACKEND_PUBLIC_URL env (defaults to https://oll.co). Make sure that env is set to the deploy domain so token links work.
critical_code_review_comments: broadcasts.py is well-structured at 560 lines — under the 700-line threshold; no need to split.
_paid_school_users / _paid_b2c_users correctly use _id:0 projection — no ObjectId leakage.
Per-recipient send is correctly rate-limited (0.25s sleep = 4/sec), within Resend free-tier 10 req/sec.
delete restricted to draft/failed only — good.
create_campaign idempotently appends unsubscribe footer if missing — verified by test_create_appends_unsubscribe_footer.
broadcast_events stores raw event in 'raw' field — could grow large; consider adding a TTL index for events older than 90 days.
AdminBroadcasts.jsx — uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly, has all required data-testids, has loading/error states with toast.
Unsubscribe.jsx — properly handles missing token, invalid token (404 → 'Link expired'), already-unsubscribed state, and confirm flow.
